nodes.label: Agent Brief
nodes.rationale: Durability over precision - briefs must survive the issue sitting for days/weeks while the codebase changes; behavioral not procedural; complete, testable acceptance criteria so the agent knows when it's done; no file paths or line numbers.

nodes.label: Acceptance Criteria
nodes.rationale: Each criterion must be concrete, testable and independently verifiable - the agent needs to know when it's done.
